description.narrative:
The "CAFI Invest" project focuses on financing projects and companies that aim to reduce deforestation and promote sustainable land-use practices across Central Africa. The project is aligned with national REDD+ strategies and CAFI's results framework through targeted interventions in sustainable agriculture, agroforestry, and forest conservation. CAFI Invest follows a three-pronged strategy operationalized through the creation of three separate investment windows. Through these windows Catalytic aims to accelerate capital flow towards sustainable land use, agroforestry, and sustainable forest management respectively, addressing at the same time both environmental and socio-economic challenges in Central Africa
Investment Windows:
Window 1: Payment for Ecosystem Services (PES) – This window incentivizes communities and landowners to preserve forest ecosystems by providing financial rewards based on the delivery of ecosystem services.
Window 2: Technical Assistance and Capital Acceleration Facility – This window provides direct technical assistance grants, venture debt, and venture capital to projects and companies at an early stage of development.
Window 3: Investment Fund – This window uses a blended finance approach to de-risk and catalyze significant additional private sector investments in various sustainable practices.
